patterns: Registry pattern: each language is a module with const query strings plus optional handler fns, wired into LanguageInfo via get_language_info() (languages/mod.rs 72-248).

Capture-name contract: element 'function' / 'func_name' / 'method_name' / 'class' / 'class_name'; call 'call'; import 'import_path'; reference 'type_ref'; defuse prefixes 'write.', 'read.', 'writeread.' (parser_elements.rs).
Inheritance by child iteration: swift.rs walks inheritance_specifier children by kind; java.rs walks named fields and checks kind; PHP clauses are unfielded so kind-based iteration is required.
DEFUSE_QUERY mirrors java.rs: declaration write, assignment write, update writeread, identifier read; PHP uses (variable_name (name)) because variable_name wraps name without the '$'.
Inline unit tests per handler plus a parse helper; a registration table test lists (lang, has_references, has_imports).

approaches.name: A. Full-parity handler, Java-shaped (recommended)
approaches.description: New languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class/interface/trait/enum declarations), CALL_QUERY (function_call_expression, member_call_expression, nullsafe_member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression, all capturing @call), IMPORT_QUERY on namespace_use_declaration (fallback full-text module), REFERENCE_QUERY on named_type, DEFUSE_QUERY (assignment, augmented/update, parameters, reads), and extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause by child kind. Set extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type to None (issue says out of scope). Wire pub mod, get_language_info arm, get_ts_language arm, EXTENSION_MAP, supported_languages, Cargo deps, Cargo.lock; add unit tests in php.rs, registration table row, integration test in crates/aptu-coder/tests/. Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) so mixed HTML templates parse.
pros: Meets every acceptance criterion in issue #1864
Same shape as java.rs and the swift.rs inheritance walk, so reviewers recognise it
Only approach that delivers calls, imports, and defuse used by analyze_file/analyze_module
DEFUSE_QUERY is required because parser.rs compiles it when present and parser_elements uses it for symbol def/use; omitting it silently disables def-use for PHP
cons: Largest diff: about 9 files touched and a Cargo.lock change

Query text is unverified against a compiled tree-sitter-php until a build runs; PHP name nodes are shared by functions, classes, calls and constants, so the queries need test coverage to avoid over-capture
Needs a dependency age check (crate published on GitHub 2026-11-19, about 8 days before this run; crates.io publish date not verified here)

approaches.name: B. Minimal: element and inheritance only
approaches.description: php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY and extract_inheritance; CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY and DEFUSE_QUERY set to empty string or None; registry wiring only.
pros: Smallest diff (about 6 files), fastest to review
cons: Fails acceptance criteria for free, ->, :: calls and use imports
Leaves DEFUSE_QUERY absent, so def-use is disabled for PHP and the issue's DEFUSE requirement is not met
Would need a follow-up PR, which conflicts with the maintainers' single in-house implementation

approaches.name: C. PHP-only grammar variant (LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY)
approaches.description: Same handler as A but wire tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY, which parses pure PHP without the HTML text mode, and reject or pre-strip .php files with HTML.
pros: Simpler node tree for pure PHP files, no text/php_tag nodes
Same crate, so the Cargo.toml and lock changes are identical to A
cons: Violates the issue's acceptance criterion that a file mixing HTML and <?php ... ?> parses with zero ERROR nodes
Would need a separate node-types check (php_only/src/node-types.json, not inspected here)
Not recommended; kept only to show the trade-off

recommendation: Approach A. The issue's acceptance criteria require calls, imports, inheritance, and the HTML-template edge case, and DEFUSE_QUERY is needed for def-use parity. Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) and mirror java.rs for queries and swift.rs for child-kind inheritance walks. Caveat: this run did not compile the queries or run cargo test (read-only scout), so the query drafts are grammar-derived and must be compile-checked by the first unit test as the issue suggests. Also note the issue states external PRs are not accepted; this is a constraint on who implements it, not on the approach.

inheritance_walk_citation: Source: tree-sitter/tree-sitter-php tag v0.25.2, common/define-grammar.js (fetched via gh api; php/grammar.js is a 3-line wrapper), plus php/src/node-types.json. Walk for class_declaration (define-grammar.js lines 365-373): optional(field('attributes', attribute_list)), repeat(_modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list). Step 1: iterate direct children of the class_declaration node. The 'extends' clause is an UNFIELDED child of kind base_clause (define-grammar.js lines 334-337: base_clause: seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name))). Step 2: for each base_clause, iterate its named children; each is a name, qualified_name, or relative_name (from _name, lines 296-302), and its raw source text is the base name. Emit 'extends <text>'. Step 3: the 'implements' clause is an UNFIELDED child of kind class_interface_clause (lines 381-384: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name))). Iterate its named children and emit 'implements <text>' for each. Step 4: the body is field 'body' of kind declaration_list (line 375); do not descend into it. Interface: interface_declaration (lines 326-333) has an optional base_clause and NO class_interface_clause, so it can emit multiple 'extends'. Enum: enum_declaration (lines 339-347) has an optional class_interface_clause and no base_clause. Trait: trait_declaration (lines 319-325) has neither clause. Field-name fact: base_clause and class_interface_clause are NOT field-accessible (child_by_field_name returns None); use child iteration by kind. node-types.json confirms class_declaration children include 'base_clause' and 'class_interface_clause'.
